WITH profile_averages AS (
  SELECT
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1
  GROUP BY o.weathprofile
),
profile_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS mean_profile_average
  FROM profile_averages
)
SELECT
  p.weathprofile,
  p.avg_bandusagepct,
  p.telescope_count,
  p.avg_bandusagepct - m.mean_profile_average AS difference_from_mean
FROM profile_averages AS p
CROSS JOIN profile_mean AS m
WHERE m.mean_profile_average IS NOT NULL;
